 VISHNU PRASAD S/O SITARAM MALVIYA, AGED ABOUT

, OCCUPATION: LABOUR GRAM  DOBDAGURJAR, TEHSIL TARANA, DISTRICT UJJAIN  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI RISHIRAJ TRIVEDI, ADVOCATE)

AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH STATION HOUSE  OFFICER THROUGH POLICE STATION NEELGANGA,
 DIST. UJJAIN (MADHYA PRADESH)

entities.text: STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH STATION HOUSE
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: This application coming on for admission this day,

the c  following:
 ORDER

This is first bail application filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of bail during trial relating to Crime No. 95/2023 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station- Neelganga, District- Ujjain, for the offence under Sections 363, 366 & 376(2)(N) of I.P.C.
and Sections 5(L) & 6 of POCSO Act, 2012.
The applicant is in custody since 09.12.2023.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the age of prosecutrix is 15 years and 08 months.
He further submits that as per statement of prosecutrix 2 MCRC-13429-2024 recorded before the trial Court, she has not supported the prosecution case and has been declared hostile.
The applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present crime.
He is in custody since 09.12.2023 i.e. more than six months have been completed.
Final conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.

sentences.text: 3. Per contra, learned counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that DNA report is against the applicant.
4. I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

5. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and custody period of the applicant, without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his/her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his/her presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
7.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
Certified Copy as per rules.
